limitations.bodyReferenceCoverage: The repeatable hash-binding audit captures 88 retained object identities and 129 selected typed body-reference rows. Normative ODA body profiles cover 40 no-body-handle records and 18 handle-bearing profiles (13 DICTIONARY, two LAYOUT, one DICTIONARYWDFLT, one TABLESTYLE, and one MLEADERSTYLE). The DICTIONARYWDFLT, TABLESTYLE, and MLEADERSTYLE profiles bind their exact source roles and rooted dictionary membership. Source-matched LibreDWG profiles cover one ACDBPLACEHOLDER, 24 VISUALSTYLE, three MATERIAL, and one SUN body; all 32 peer identities, frame sizes, owners, and reactors match minJSON from the same Cover source. MATERIAL’s three AC1027 defaults pass bounded semantic decoding, but output remains refused because modern body/string replay is incomplete. SUN’s body has no H fields before common handles; its VPORT owner edge is independently supported by ODA §20.4.81 group 361. Only 3DSOLID remains a selected typed report without exhaustive body-reference proof. No body is classified as unknown. This inventory does not qualify DXF output or general semantics; LAYOUT retains the separate ODA RL versus observed BL viewport-count discrepancy.
limitations.decision: Preserve the global AC1027 strict-source guard. Bounded body-reference classification covers 87/88 retained frames: 40 normative no-body-handle, 18 normative handle-reference, and 29 source-matched peer no-body-handle profiles; 43 dictionary-membership edges are recorded. The 3DSOLID frame remains a partial selected report. The three AC1027 default MATERIAL records have bounded semantic read profiles, but no output claim follows because modern body/string replay remains refused. No guard narrowing or output-support promotion follows from this inventory.
